notes.title: 0.2.03_beta
notes.notes:
LODs will be all whack-a-doodle until next update... but here are these fixes as reported by you testers. THANKS AGAIN!!!! 

+ Fixed doors in Yellow Key cabinet
 + Fixed Garden Gnome collider errors
 + Fixed Time Achievement trigger
 + Fixed Building2 Lamp's generator triggers
 + Added another snack to Doll reward
 + Added knob to inside of Doll door
 + Changed Y button to also open In Game Menu
 + Changed ladder rungs to be allowed in front pockets
 + Changed slight increase to max player step up height
 + Changed some erroneous objects back to static or dynamic
 + Changed some grabbable large objects to active head collision camera
 + Changed Building3 smoke to move slower
 + Changed Increased object depenetration velocity (Unity's way of trying to keep colliders from going into each other)
 + Lots of work towards making Home scene explorable instead of just being a "3D Credits" (Much more to go though)
+ Adjustments to Swamp VFX culling

notes.title: 0.2.01_beta_test
notes.notes:
With all the puzzles complete and the objective attainable... bug fixes and polish are all that is left... and I am officially moving this out of [b]ALPHA[/b] and into [b]BETA[/b]. Sooooooo close to release it's making me itchy. hahaha

 + Fixed water sometimes coming over top of escape boat.
 + Fixed Bonehead Lock distorting some objects
 + Updated Pa's video monitors
 + Updated temp smoke to detailed smoke on Building 3.
 + Updates to many object Textures
 + Updates to many Materials to enable GPU Instancing
 + Added spark and ash FX to Building 3 Fireplace.
 + Added New VOs for Horror Doll 
 + Added TV Remote to the Home scene
 + Added Multiple screens to TV for credits and stats
 + Added some more small details to scenes
 + Tweaks to a few object LODs

PLEASE send me any and all bug reports and feedback on puzzles here or on Discord!!!
